description: This file defines the PartyTypeHelper class in the org.apache.ofbiz.party.party package. It provides a static method checkPartyType that verifies whether a specific party identified by partyId is of a certain party type (PERSON or PARTY_GROUP), using OFBiz's entity query mechanisms.

classes.name: PartyTypeHelper
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods for handling operations related to party types within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: checkPartyType
methods.description: Checks if the party with the given partyId is of the specified partyType (e.g., PERSON or PARTY_GROUP). Returns false if an error occurs or if the party/type does not match.
